units: provisional map units; visual/model scaling remains to validate

designBrief.playerPromise: Orchestrate a small team that builds a Product while protecting it.
designBrief.feeling: Welcoming, understandable and forgiving, with one meaningful placement lesson at a time.
designBrief.repeatedDecision: Allocate local coverage to Work or Problems as the mix changes.
designBrief.reward: Completed Work funds the team, heals capped Product health and contributes visual Product Progress.
designBrief.risk: Ignored Problems damage Product health; unfinished Work forfeits rewards and adds Technical Debt.
designBrief.mastery: Read exposure and sight, spread coverage across the route, and use a Tester where it improves real completion and defense.

coreLoopContract: Place and configure Copilots to complete moving Work and resolve Problems before they reach the Product; successful Work earns Compute, capped healing and visual growth, while missed Work adds debt and leaked Problems damage Product health.

levelPlan.spatialFormat: One readable planar authored route, one deliberate Server blocker and free placement within valid areas.
levelPlan.firstDecision: Buy three Base Copilots or invest in two specialized Copilots using the proposed opening budget.
levelPlan.firstThreat: One readable Bug after productive Work has shown completion and reward.
levelPlan.firstReward: A visible Work completion payout before mixed traffic creates competition.
levelPlan.escalation: Six normal rounds introduce productive Work, Bugs, specialization, modes, then light ambiguity; Debt Sprint and incident follow.
levelPlan.recovery: Maintain useful late coverage and a safe planning break before each round.
levelPlan.camera: Fixed orthographic isometric view; entry, Server and Product remain visible together at phone scale.

candidateBalance.roundStructure: Six normal rounds, Debt Sprint, Production Incident; pacing and script unapproved.

concepts.name: Hello World Courtyard
concepts.theme: A welcoming landscaped development courtyard with a tiny pond, rounded trees and a compact Product studio.
concepts.strength: Clearest introduction and most room for recovery.
concepts.risk: Keep foliage, fences and decoration away from the working route; avoid making the middle bend universally best.

concepts.name: Creekside Compute
concepts.theme: A riverside development lab with a low fixed bridge, cooling equipment, stone banks and open greenery.
concepts.strength: Most memorable natural setting; strong entry and destination separation.
concepts.risk: Water can remove useful placement space. A bridge needs visual art and placement exclusion, while movement stays on the same planar route.

concepts.name: Launch Garden
concepts.theme: A small startup maker garden with planters, a solar canopy, workshop and a Product launch studio.
concepts.strength: Strong first-release story and a slightly more deliberate placement puzzle.
concepts.risk: Keep the two straight legs beyond one tower's shared reach; reserve the inner turn for a limited, obstructed coverage choice.
